threats.title: UE–satellite link spoofing
threats.description: A transmitter inside the beam imitates network signalling on the service radio link.
threats.actor: Attacker with a radio transmitter inside the beam.
threats.conditions: Suitable transmitter and protocol skill. Authentication limits success.
threats.controls: 5G mutual authentication and signalling integrity protection are assumed active.
threats.consequence: Potential effect on UEs in the area. Success against the assumed controls is not established.
threats.feasibility_reason: Specialist transmitter and protocol skill are required. Authentication limits success.
threats.impact_reason: The supplied record assumes effects on UEs sharing access in the area.
threats.confidence_reason: Low in the supplied update. Ratings depend on stated assumptions and unchecked source support.

evidence.note: The supplied update cites 5G security. It does not identify a supporting section for this specific spoofing path.
NTN architecture context is cited. The specific attack path remains unverified.
The actor can reach the relevant beam. Several-user consequences are assumed. Successful bypass of mutual authentication is not demonstrated.

mitigations.text: Mutual authentication and cryptographic signing of access requests.
mitigations.note: Candidate copied from the supplied update. Specific source support and suitability for S1 still require a human check.

threats.title: Satellite relay eavesdropping
threats.description: A passive receiver in the footprint observes radio traffic. The record concerns metadata rather than decryption of ciphertext.
threats.actor: Passive receiver in the satellite footprint.
threats.conditions: Receiving equipment and access to the relevant radio signal.
threats.consequence: Limited metadata exposure. Ciphertext is not assumed to be decrypted.
threats.feasibility_reason: The supplied record assumes a commodity receiver and no privileged access.
threats.impact_reason: Metadata can be exposed but ciphertext is not assumed to be decrypted.
threats.confidence_reason: Medium in the supplied update. Relevance to S1 and section-level source support remain unchecked.

evidence.note: The update cites 5G security for context. Ciphering is an assumption for this scenario.
A maritime VSAT paper is cited. Transfer of its findings to this transparent LEO 5G scenario has not been established.
Receiver feasibility and visible metadata depend on the selected radio environment. These details are not provided.
